sharedRules: Use the canonical character atlas as the edit target and the supplied product image as garment reference.
Preserve face, eyes, muzzle, ears, mane, tail, body, arms, hoof-hands, legs, hooves, identity, direction, cell order, scale and transparency.
Fit the shirt over the upper torso and upper arms, behind mane and tail, with hoof-hands visible and a straight upper-hip hem.
Use no readable text. Preserve garment details consistently through all sixteen directions.
Create open-eye fitting references only; the runtime applies the same garment overlay to independently registered blink atlases.

garments.black-ivory-retro-bowling-shirt: Black camp collar and body, ivory vertical front panels, red piping, cream buttons, black chest pockets with ivory welts, and tiny non-text pinstripe embroidery. Rear remains black with restrained red piping.
garments.burgundy-hot-rod-bowling-shirt: Burgundy camp shirt with black collar, black/red cuff trim, dark buttons and a small non-text front chest mark. Put the large cream/black/red vintage hot-rod and pinstripe graphic only on rear-facing views.
garments.ivory-black-flame-shirt: Warm ivory camp-collar button shirt with dark buttons and a subtle chest pocket. Wrap the black hem band and bold black flames continuously around the lower shirt on every direction.

characterRules.eddy: Preserve Eddy's warm chestnut coat and black mane/tail exactly.
characterRules.noir: Preserve Noir's dark coat, blue eyes, white forehead diamond, black mane/tail and silver bridle exactly.

shopCutouts.rules: Reconstruct only the specified garment as one centered, fully visible product cutout with no body, mannequin, hanger, text, or other garment, on a transparent background.
